summary: A school or community club asks members and parents for volunteers.
realLife: Census data show parents with children under 18 volunteered at 30 percent versus 21 percent for people without children at home; ages 16 and 17 had the highest rate.
sources: U.S. Census Bureau, volunteering and civic life story: https://census.gov/library/stories/2023/01/volunteering-and-civic-life-in-america.html
inGame: needs: a club or volunteer group record; a school record and parent ties exist

turns.summary: The person signs up for a single Saturday.
The person ends up running the committee.
The person says no and the asker moves to someone else.
